name: PlayTales
description: A child-friendly player for audio plays and audiobooks, seamlessly connected to Apple Music. Clear, simple, and built for small hands — originally made for my own kids.

name: PhotoMemo+
tagline: The classic pairs game, built from your own photos
description: Not stock animals — your family. Photo Memo+ turns pictures from your photo library into a memory board for two to four players. One purchase, no ads, no account, and nothing needs an internet connection.

name: TV Graphs
tagline: Episode rating charts for every TV series
description: Browse what's popular, search the full catalogue, and dive into per-season episode rating charts. A universal SwiftUI app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, powered by The Movie Database.

name: The Shed
description: Learn the song before rehearsal. The Shed splits any song you own into stems, mutes your part and lets you play along with the rest of the band. Loop a section, slow it down, change the key, read the chords. Everything runs on your iPad or Mac: no account, no upload.

name: Inquizitive
tagline: A fact-checked quiz on anything you're curious about
description: Type any topic and Apple Intelligence writes ten questions, researched on Wikipedia while they're written, with an explanation and a source for every answer. Retry what you missed until it sticks. Free to try, no account, on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Vision Pro.

name: Karacho
tagline: Your GPS speed in big amber digits
description: A full-screen digital speedometer for iPhone: your speed in large seven-segment digits you can read at a glance, with a symbol for walking, cycling or driving. Free to use, no account, no analytics. Pro, a one-time purchase, adds the Siri answer and your speed on the Lock Screen.
